headlines.headline: LEBRON JAMES SIGNS WITH 76ERS AFTER EIGHT SEASONS WITH THE LAKERS
headlines.detail: Draymond Green re-signs with Warriors on a one-year, $27.7M deal; full 2026-27 schedule drops Thursday, Aug. 13 at 3 PM ET on ESPN2.

headlines.headline: TRAINING CAMP INJURY WAVE HITS LIONS AND JETS AS SEASON OPENERS DRAW NEAR
headlines.detail: Lions lose C Cade Mays (hand fracture) and RB Isiah Pacheco (torn MCL); Jets CB Qwan'tez Stiggers hospitalized after collapsing at practice.

headlines.headline: PORTAL TREND: COACHES BRING THEIR OWN PLAYERS TO NEW PROGRAMS AS 2026 CAMPS OPEN
headlines.detail: Eric Morris brought 21 former North Texas players to Oklahoma State; Whittingham took Utah's John Henry Daley to Michigan; Campbell's Penn State roster features ~2 dozen ex-Iowa State players.

headlines.headline: COURT DENIES NCAA'S BID TO STAY ELIGIBILITY INJUNCTION AS NEW LAWSUIT ADDS MIAMI'S MALIK RENEAU, SOUTH CAROLINA'S MIKE SHARAVJAMTS
headlines.detail: Colorado federal judge upholds blanket fifth-year eligibility for the 2022-23 class; fresh South Carolina suit seeks to extend the same relief league-wide.
